name: Personal trainer

google_prefill.phone: [G] the listed phone (stays the business's; customers use Rosie's one number)

A.flow: A: the customer comes to the business (video or phone count as A)
A.staff: Mateo and Jade (trainers at the studio)

services.name: 60-minute session
services.story: The main story: Alex buys a 5-session pack, $275 ($55 a session), and the first 60-minute session with Mateo uses one. A no-show can use one up, if Sam confirms.

services.name: 30-minute session
services.story: A single 30-minute session, $35. The front desk is closed on Saturday mornings, so the saved card is charged when Mateo texts DONE.

services.name: 30-minute session
services.story: A single 30-minute session, $35. A card is saved for the studio's $20 fee, and Alex pays at the front desk.

B.flow: B: the business goes to the customer

services.name: 60-minute session at home
services.story: The main story: a $179 60-minute session at Alex's home with Andre. A card is saved and charged $179 when Andre texts DONE.

services.name: Session at home (3-session pack)
services.story: A 3-session pack at home, $450 ($150 a session), paid in full when booking. Each session uses one, and a no-show can use one up, if Sam confirms.

services_shape: one person's time: a session with a named trainer, booked by the trainer's free hours, at the studio, the client's home or a park; a partner session adds a second person
questions_before_times: new or returning (a new client gets the free assessment, the health questions and the waiver first)
what to work on: strength, weight, mobility, a sport
where: the studio, at home, or in a park
a single session, a pack or a weekly plan
one person or two (a partner session)
safety_stop: someone unwell right now: chest pain, trouble breathing, fainting, or sudden weakness
license: from the state form: personal training usually needs no state license; some places register trainers or fitness businesses; sports massage needs a license where the state's rules require it
staff_skills: strength, mobility, teens, pre- and postnatal, older adults; teen sessions only with trainers cleared for minors
messages_never: health answers, injuries, pregnancy, a doctor's note and incident notes never go in a text or through the AI: only the secure page and the client's record
demo_note: Demo data for testing only. [G] = prefilled from the business's Google listing at sign-up; the owner checks each field.
